vectors.description: LOC-01 interpretation of all four known properties from a structured PropertyMap.
Duplicate Capture Timestamp: current behavior silently keeps the LAST value (regression pin of the Layer-B policy the resolver must reproduce).
An unknown even property with a near-2^64 id is preserved losslessly. The unknown map is bigint-keyed so the id survives intact (the Layer-B contract).
Audio Level value 0x1FF: current behavior silently masks to the low 8 bits (level 127, voice active) — regression pin.
Capture Timestamp of 0.
Capture Timestamp above 2^53-1 (Number-safety probe); kept exact as bigint.
Capture Timestamp at the QUIC-varint maximum (2^62-1).
Video Frame Marking (RFC 9626) independent-frame bit set.
Audio Level (RFC 6464) magnitude 127, no voice activity.
Video Config (odd id 13) length-prefixed codec extradata.
All four known LOC-01 properties in one block.
An unknown even id (32, varint) and unknown odd id (33, bytes) are preserved in the unknown map (each with an explicit null name).
The value varint (8-byte QUIC form) runs off the end.
An odd-id (Video Config) declares length 10 but only 2 value bytes remain.
